subject: Reuse dbHasNoKeys() inside dbsHaveNoKeys() to remove duplicate logic (#2800)
reason: The change replaces the inlined emptiness check in dbsHaveNoKeys() with a call to the existing dbHasNoKeys() helper. Within the loop bounds [0, server.dbnum) the helper's added range checks are always false, so it evaluates to exactly the same condition the old code tested (!server.db[i] || kvstoreSize(server.db[i]->keys) == 0). The function's return value is unchanged for all inputs; this is a pure refactor removing duplicate logic, with no observable behaviour to test.
